Slop Docs · free, in your browser

A free word processor in your browser

Write a letter, a report or notes on real pages in a browser tab. Slop Docs needs no installation and no account, and your document stays on your device.

Start writing

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Docs. A blank document is ready, or choose File, New, Random template for a designed start.
  2. Type, and format with the toolbar: font and size, bold, italic, underline, alignment, bulleted and numbered lists.
  3. Pick a paragraph style: Normal, Title, Heading 1 to 3, Quote or Code.
  4. Choose Save to Slop Drive to keep it in this browser (Ctrl+S).
  5. Choose File, Download Word (.docx) to send it, or Print to print it.

While you type, a draft is saved in this browser every second or so, so a closed tab does not lose your work.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Docs runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Do I need an account?

No. Slop Docs saves to Slop Drive, which lives in this browser on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.

Can I open the document in Word?

Yes. Download Word (.docx) writes headings, lists, tables, fonts, alignment and page size that Word and LibreOffice open.

Can I make a PDF?

Choose Print and pick Save as PDF in your browser's print dialog. A direct PDF export is not built yet.

What is not supported yet?

Pictures, headers and footers, footnotes and comments are not built yet, and tables can be shown but not edited.
